subject: Re: Contract amendment and MOP for EU edge + APAC warm-standby
messages:
From: Emma Singh <emma.singh@medhaven.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@medhaven.com
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SOW questions — EU edge + APAC standby

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the draft SOW and procurement had a few clarifying questions before we kick off renewal discussions: 

- Can the EU edge node be single-tenant for our production traffic?
- We need an explicit failover path to APAC warm-standby in case of EU regional outage — what does the SLA look like across regions?
- Pricing: we'd like a 12-month committed term but with the option to top up tokens in Q4 if demand spikes.

I've cc'd procurement (procure@medhaven.com) so they can flag any paperwork constraints. Attached the SOW you sent.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Singh
Senior PM, ML Platform
MedHaven
[Attachment: SOW_EU_edge_v1.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Emma Singh <emma.singh@medhaven.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SOW questions — EU edge + APAC standby

Emma —

Appreciate the notes. Short answers up front:

- Yes, we can provision a single-tenant EU edge pool for production (reserved capacity) and give you a dedicated tenancy flag in the account config.
- Cross-region failover: our routing policy supports active-primary (EU) with APAC warm-standby. Failover target is an APAC capacity pool with automatic model variant fallback. We guarantee cross-region failover within the SLA window when warm-standby is active (details below).
- Pricing: we'll propose a 12-month committed SKU with a Q4 top-up option and an upsell credit for bringing committed token volume above the baseline.

I've attached a slightly annotated SOW with the tenancy and failover bullets called out. Ben and Hannah are on the thread for ops/implementation notes. Proposed next step: 30-minute call early next week to walk procurement and confirm the mutual action plan.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
[Attachment: SOW_EU_edge_v1.pdf (annotated)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Emma Singh <emma.singh@medhaven.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SOW questions — EU edge + APAC standby

Emma — quick technical note before the call: 

- We'll provide a deployment diagram showing the EU single-tenant pool, APAC warm-standby routing, and the canary switch procedure. See attached diagram.
- Warm-standby will maintain a warmed KV cache for hot prefixes; cold-start paths are still possible for large seqs but we mitigate with pre-warming for your top 20 prompts.

Attaching the deployment diagram and a preliminary timeline.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: deployment_diagram.png]

From: procure@medhaven.com (MedHaven Procurement)
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Emma Singh <emma.singh@medhaven.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Procurement - contract redlines and compliance checklist

Hi Jonas / team,

Procurement forwarded our standard redlines and compliance checklist. Key asks: 

1) Data residency: we need a contractual guarantee that EU production traffic and derived embeddings are stored and retained in EU geo at rest.
2) Audit logs: 12-month retention exported to our S3 bucket with delivery cadence.
3) Subprocessors: full list and commitment to notify changes 30 days in advance.
4) Pricing breakout: committed token baseline, overage rates, and Q4 top-up mechanics.

Please respond with the redline-friendly SOW and a price table. We attached the procurement_requirements.docx for your reference.

Procurement Contact
MedHaven
[Attachment: procurement_requirements.docx]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: procure@medhaven.com, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement - contract redlines and compliance checklist

Hi team —

Addressing the procurement asks: 

- Data residency: we'll add a residency clause for production token storage and embeddings, scoped to the EU single-tenant pool. Exports and backups for the EU pool will remain in-region. We cannot guarantee analytics derived from aggregate anonymized usage that runs in a centralized analytics cluster (we'll add an exception and a process to request in-region analytics).
- Audit logs: we can export logs to MedHaven's S3 on a weekly cadence with an encrypted transfer and 12-month retention; please provide the target bucket and a contact for IAM exchange.
- Subprocessors: attaching our current subprocessors list; we will commit to 30-days notice for changes.
- Pricing: attached is a price_breakout_Q4.xlsx with committed baseline, overage tiers, and the Q4 top-up flow (credit application and pro-rata mechanics). 

Technical note on failover: cross-region failover will preserve session continuity for short-lived chats (<= 40 tokens prefix warm-cache). For longer context sessions we recommend session migration strategy outlined in the MOP.

Link to the migration MOP draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSOW-EU-EDGE

Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Inference Runtime
[Attachment: price_breakout_Q4.xlsx]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract amendment and MOP for EU edge + APAC warm-standby

Emma / Procurement —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary and proposed MAP: 

- Term: 12-month committed (Oct 1, 2025 — Sep 30, 2026) with Q4 top-up credit option.
- Capacity: EU single-tenant reserved pool (baseline X tokens/month). APAC warm-standby configured with automatic failover and the SLA clause for cross-region fallback included in the SOW.
- Data residency & logs: residency clause + weekly S3 audit export (we need the target bucket and IAM point of contact).
- Pricing: see attached price_breakout_Q4.xlsx; DL-7829 assigned as the deal id.
- Next steps: procurement to send redlines into DocuSign for the contract amendment. Ops/Eng (Ben/Karthik) to schedule a technical runbook walk-through and canary window: proposed Oct 12–14 for internal staging canary, Oct 19 for production cutover.

Can everyone confirm by EOD Monday 22-Sep? If agreed, I'll open the DocuSign envelope and loop legal.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
